- Locate sender VAT (VAT/UID-Nr near sender details).
- Find grand total (zu erstattender Betrag) and VAT group lines (Netto, Ust %, Ust).
- Extract numeric values preserving decimal places and convert percentages to numeric without "%" per rules.
- Do not infer missing values.

- Contains invoice indicators: "GUTSCHRIFT", "Rechnungsnummer", "Rechnungsdatum", "Nettobetrag", "Ust %", "zu erstattender Betrag" — treat as invoice/credit note.

- GrandTotal.Amount:

- VAT group (Vat.Rate, Net.Amount, Vat.Amount):
  - The summary shows Netto = 3.074,30, Ust % = 10 %, Ust = 307,43.
  - Vat.Rate = 10 (no percent symbol), Net.Amount = 3074.30, Vat.Amount = 307.43.

No other VAT groups or exchange rates applicable to the whole invoice found. No fields require inference.
